svg.title: Skill map
svg.desc: The core path runs from using-nuclear-grade through questioning-attitude, rating-change-risk, creating-change-records, proving-claims, checking-release-readiness, recording-a-known-good-version and learning-from-experience, which feeds back to questioning-attitude. Rating-change-risk branches to choosing-what-to-control and checking-what-a-change-affects. Heavier overlays switch on by consequence, each labeled with its trigger. A colored stripe gives each skill's family (start here, before you act, records and versions, evidence and verdicts, trust and public claims, delegation and structure, when it goes wrong); a gold dot marks the Core 7, which apply to every change.
svg.text: SKILL MAP · CORE PATH AND CONSEQUENCE OVERLAYS
HEAVIER OVERLAYS — SWITCH ON BY CONSEQUENCE
